# HTTP reference

Every route the server exposes, and what it asks of a caller.

A route marked `token` needs `Authorization: Bearer <KB_ARENA_API_TOKEN>`.
A route marked `token, unless local or a published demo` returns corpus
content: it is open to a caller on this machine, open in a demo an
operator published, and closed otherwise.

| Route | Method | Auth |
|---|---|---|
| `/api/arena/leaderboard` | GET | open |
| `/api/arena/match` | POST | token |
| `/api/arena/vote` | POST | token |
| `/api/benchmark/results` | GET | token, unless local or a published demo |
| `/api/compare` | GET | token, unless local or a published demo |
| `/api/corpora` | GET | open |
| `/api/debug/explain` | POST | token |
| `/api/graph/build` | POST | token |
| `/api/graph/build/stream/{build_id}` | GET | token |
| `/api/graph/data` | GET | token, unless local or a published demo |
| `/api/leaderboard` | GET | open |
| `/api/retriever-lab/runs` | GET | open |
| `/api/retriever-lab/{run_id}` | GET | token, unless local or a published demo |
| `/api/tools/audit` | POST | token |
| `/api/tools/fix` | POST | token |
| `/api/tools/generate` | POST | token |
| `/api/tools/qa-pairs` | GET | token, unless local or a published demo |
| `/chat` | POST | token |
| `/chat/stream` | POST | token |
